460bb89df78db423.description: About the Role Tabuk Pharmaceuticals is seeking a Key Account Specialist to join their team in Abha. This full-time position is ideal for candidates with 1-3 years of experience who are looking to develop their career in pharmaceutical key account management. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain a database of tender timetables, potential opportunities, and decision-makers to establish new business channels. Identify and capture ad-hoc (direct purchase) business opportunities through regular visits to Key Accounts and engagement with relevant personnel (Purchasers, Pharmacists). Initiate and negotiate Requests for Quotation (RFQs), prepare and deliver quotations, and secure approvals. Process purchasing orders and submit them to the appropriate department. Leverage synergies with other territory teams and field players to maximize outcomes. Introduce and promote existing products and new launches to doctors, clinical pharmacists, Product Technical Committees, and pharmacists, including managing evaluation studies as required. Manage the promotional budget to ensure a balance between scientific support for customers and return on investment. Participate in trade shows, conferences, standalone meetings, group meetings, and conventions. Plan for target achievement and allocate efforts across accounts. Report weekly on plan progress, identify gaps, and propose action plans for resolution. Prepare and update reports on customer profiles, needs, challenges, interests, competitive activities, and potential for new products and services. Conduct market research for products currently under registration. Report on product applications, technical services, market conditions, competitive activities, and advertising and promotional trends through various channels. Maintain and frequently update the company database. Ensure the confidentiality of all work-related documents and information. Perform other job-related duties as required by business needs. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's Degree in Pharmacy. 1-3 years of experience in a similar position. Saudi national. Experience Level This role requires 1-3 years of professional experience, making it suitable for early-career professionals. Work Environment and Location The Key Account Specialist will operate in a full-time capacity, based in Abha, contributing to the regional team's objectives. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply.

46c19f36bc38e6b2.description: About the Role Saudi Lebanese Factories For Chocolate & Confectionery LTD is seeking a Logistics Coordinator to join its manufacturing facility in Jeddah. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and involves supporting logistics, procurement, import/export, and inventory operations. The salary range for this role is SAR 3,750 - SAR 5,625. Key Responsibilities Register products in the ERP system. Prepare import and export documentation. Coordinate with customs clearance agents, freight forwarders, and 3PL providers. Handle product registration with SFDA and SABER. Issue SFDA pre-notifications for imported raw materials. Manage inventory, storage, and transportation. Follow up with suppliers and vendors regarding prices and availability. Prepare purchase orders and verify received items. Negotiate prices with suppliers. Prepare daily and weekly operational reports. Monitor inventory movements and quantities. Process product photos and designs using Photoshop or similar software. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 years and a maximum of 5 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to manage logistics, procurement, import/export, and inventory operations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in our manufacturing facility in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a team to ensure efficient and compliant logistics operations.

465be670262c674b.description: About the Role Hilti Saudi Arabia is seeking a Field Engineer to join their team in the Riyadh Region. This full-time role is designed for customer-focused professionals with 3-5 years of experience, aiming to drive sales of engineering products by collaborating with customers, sales teams, contractors, and designers. Key Responsibilities Educate key influencers in construction projects on the advantages and value of Hilti products to secure their specifications during the design phase. Conduct site visits to provide solutions and identify new opportunities. Offer technical advice, solutions, and support to clients. Add value through the effective application of Hilti products. Required Qualifications and Experience 3-5 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated customer focus and ability to work effectively with various stakeholders including sales teams, contractors, and designers. About Hilti Saudi Arabia Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, operating with over 34,000 team members across 120 countries. The company's purpose is "Making Construction Better," focusing on continuous learning, growth, and creating a lasting impact. Hilti fosters an environment where team members are empowered to utilize their strengths, collaborate within a global and inclusive team, and address meaningful challenges. Commitment to Inclusion Hilti prioritizes inclusion in its work, leadership, and growth strategies. The company is committed to embracing diverse perspectives and cultivating an inclusive environment globally. Efforts are continuously made to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute, thereby strengthening teams, innovation, and overall impact in the construction industry.

46b1cc99614d930d.description: About the Role Hyatt Regency Riyadh Olaya is seeking a Director of Sales and Marketing to lead its commercial efforts in Riyadh. This full-time position requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in the hospitality sector, focusing on driving market presence and achieving business objectives within a dynamic environment. Role Overview The Director of Sales and Marketing will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive strategies across various market segments. This role involves leading a sales and marketing team, fostering key relationships, and enhancing brand visibility to ensure sustainable growth for the hotel in Riyadh's competitive market. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute comprehensive sales, marketing, and communication strategies across all segments, including corporate, government, leisure, MICE, F&B, and events. Lead and inspire the sales and marketing team, fostering accountability and innovation. Strengthen relationships with key accounts and partners to position Hyatt Regency Riyadh as a preferred choice for travelers. Enhance brand visibility through PR, digital, and social media campaigns aligned with global initiatives. Monitor market trends and competitor activity to proactively adjust strategies. Collaborate with the General Manager, Revenue, and Operations teams to ensure sustainable growth. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Marketing, Hospitality, or a related field. Over 10 years of experience in sales and marketing, with a focus on leading international hotel brands. Demonstrated strong leadership, negotiation, and strategic thinking skills. Culturally sensitive with the ability to engage diverse audiences effectively. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh and involves working within a team-oriented environment at Hyatt Regency Riyadh Olaya. The position is full-time, contributing to the hotel's operational and strategic goals. 463d014ab40d07f9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الرمال البلاتينيه عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل العمليات المحاسبية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المالية اللازمة. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. متابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها بشكل دوري. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات المحاسبية. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. تطوير الأساليب المحاسبية يُتوقع من المحاسب في هذا الدور المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة المتبعة في الشركة. يشمل ذلك مواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في مجال المحاسبة لضمان تطبيق أفضل الممارسات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من اكتمال شروطها القانونية والمالية. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإعداد التقارير المالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات المحاسبية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

46bc7409a8d8a68e.description: About the Role Kent is seeking a Senior Site/Construction Piping Engineer to join their team in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position, requiring 48 hours per week, focused on the end-to-end execution of piping and structural construction scope at various sites within Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran, Al Jubail, Al-Ahsa, Ras Tannurah, Al Khafji, and Buqayq. The role involves overseeing all aspects from engineering drawing review to the physical fabrication, erection, and tie-in of piping systems, ensuring compliance with project standards and safety regulations. Key Responsibilities Provide technical oversight for piping/structural work areas and supervise the preparation of Construction/Installation Work Packages (CWPs/IWPs) and site deliverables. Review IFC drawings, P&IDs, isometrics, piping GA drawings, pipe support drawings, and structural drawings. Mark up redline drawings based on actual field conditions, approved field changes, and site deviations, and coordinate their formal incorporation into as-built documentation. Supervise piping spool fabrication, erection, shop/field welding, and flanged/welded tie-ins according to approved specifications. Oversee the installation of pipe supports, pipe racks, and associated structural steel (platforms, handrails, gratings, ladders) that support the piping scope. Coordinate pipe routing and support locations with structural design and existing infrastructure to resolve potential issues before fabrication/erection. Follow up on hydro testing and reinstatement packages for piping systems. Identify and resolve discrepancies from approved designs, raising Technical Queries (TQs) as needed. Ensure compliance with applicable project Piping Design Procedures, Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards (SAES/SAEP), and international standards such as ASME, API, and AISC. Coordinate with QA/QC for inspection requests, hold points, and non-conformance report (NCR) close-outs. Support Mechanical Completion and pre-commissioning handover activities. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in site or construction piping engineering. Demonstrated experience in reviewing engineering drawings and preparing construction work packages. Proficiency in supervising fabrication, erection, and tie-in of piping systems. Familiarity with Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards and Procedures (SAES/SAEP) and international standards like ASME, API, and AISC. Quality and Safety Compliance The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that all piping and structural activities are executed safely, to the required quality, and in line with the project schedule, approved drawings, and specifications. This includes strict adherence to Kent’s ISO accredited QMS and project-specific procedures. The employee shall observe all Health, Safety, Sustainability, Environment, and Quality rules of Kent, its clients, and the governing authorities of Saudi Arabia. Professional Development In consultation with the Construction Manager, the engineer will take responsibility for identifying personal development needs and ensuring agreed development goals are met. The role also involves performing related duties as instructed. Work Location This full-time position is based in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia, with potential assignments across Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran, Al Jubail, Al-Ahsa, Ras Tannurah, Al Khafji, and Buqayq.

46efdc3d697fd54b.job_title: Deputy Resident Engineer Civil (Saudi National Only)
46efdc3d697fd54b.description: About SYSTRA and the Role SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA designs transport solutions and contributes to urban development by creating, improving, and modernizing infrastructure and transport systems across their project life cycles in over 80 countries. This full-time position for a Deputy Resident Engineer - Civil (Saudi National Only) is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and supports SYSTRA’s Mobility & Railway Business Unit on new metro projects. Role Overview The Deputy Resident Engineer (Civil) will provide engineering and technical support for all Civil works performed on site within an assigned rail project area. This role involves monitoring contractor activities, ensuring project delivery aligns with specifications and schedules, and maintaining quality assurance oversight. The position requires 5-10 years of experience, with a focus on major civil or infrastructure projects, particularly within rail, metro, or related transportation sectors. Key Responsibilities Monitor and coordinate contractor activities to ensure safe and efficient project delivery. Develop and monitor discipline-specific construction schedules against project milestones. Provide schedule updates, progress assessments, and reporting to the Construction Manager. Monitor material procurement, delivery, and availability to maintain construction schedules. Verify that delivered materials comply with project specifications, quality requirements, and industry standards. Maintain first-level quality assurance oversight for installation works in accordance with approved plans and specifications. Supervise construction engineering activities and provide technical expertise across construction disciplines. Ensure inspections and testing activities are conducted, witnessed, documented, and completed per approved procedures. Collaborate with construction management teams to identify and mitigate safety, environmental, and operational risks. Promote safe work practices and ensure compliance with site-specific safety requirements. Coordinate with design engineering teams to support construction and resolve technical issues. Review and interpret design drawings and specifications to ensure work execution aligns with the latest approved revisions. Provide technical solutions to engineering and construction challenges and coordinate implementation. Maintain project records, progress reports, back-charge documentation, and other project controls documentation. Coordinate and organize project documentation for final handover and closeout activities. Interface with clients, contractors, and senior management to support project execution. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field. Minimum of 8 years of post-graduate experience on major civil or infrastructure projects. Demonstrated experience on rail, metro, transit, or related transportation projects. Proven experience leading and managing multidisciplinary engineering and construction teams. Required Skills Strong problem-solving, coordination, and organizational skills. Experience with construction materials testing and quality assurance, including soil, concrete, grout, dewatering, and load testing activities. Strong understanding of construction planning, material delivery, staging, scheduling, and site coordination. Knowledge of construction quality, safety, and compliance requirements. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. SYSTRA is an equal opportunities company, and this position is open to all qualified Saudi National applicants.

467e879aefcf1cdd.description: About the Role GE Vernova is seeking a Commissioning Specialist to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on performing services and maintenance activities on customer sites. The role involves contributing to, maintaining, repairing, and refurbishing sold or existing products, encompassing both preventive and remedial maintenance services, managing maintenance facilities, and field services engineering. Key Responsibilities Execute all activities related to the testing and validation of equipment, facilities, or plants in accordance with design objectives or specifications for operational use. Apply general business knowledge and understand how team work contributes to the overall area. Resolve issues using established procedures, consulting supervisors for matters outside defined instructions. Collaborate with others to address issues and, for customer-facing roles, develop strong customer relationships, serving as the interface between the customer and GE. Manage activities related to SAS commissioning on customer sites, from site mobilization to commissioning work. Ensure customer and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements are determined, understood, and consistently met. Demonstrate EHS leadership and ensure the Zero Deviation Plan is implemented within the team. Comply with Quality Procedures, work instructions, Processes, and compliance rules, resolving non-conformances in a timely manner. Build relationships with GA customers and business stakeholders, including National Grid standard & qualification, projects and operations teams, contractors, and system integrators. Required Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of experience in a relevant field. Experience in SAS systems with technical skills using PC /DSagile/Aview software. Experience in communication with Protection and control systems, as well as 3rd party IEDs integration. NG CSD approval for SAS activities is required. Desired Characteristics Possess a growth mindset and the ability to act on constructive criticism. Demonstrate a commitment to EHS culture and I&D agenda. Ability to manage customer, partner, and external relations under pressure while maintaining focus on business/project goals. Ability to influence internal stakeholders and functions to achieve common project goals. Ability to communicate key project issues to senior leadership with appropriate visual aids. Ability to foster team dynamics and shared ownership of project goals. Strong sense of urgency and drive for results. Natural inclination to be a change agent and contribute to wider business operational improvement initiatives. Work Environment This role operates within an international company with matrix organizations, requiring adaptability and collaboration across diverse teams and stakeholders. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary information will be disclosed during the interview process.

468735b00dccbdf5.company_name: King Abdullah bin Abdulaziz University Hospital
468735b00dccbdf5.description: About the Role King Abdullah bin Abdelaziz University is seeking a Paramedic III to join its Division of Emergency Medical Services. This full-time role involves providing professional pre-hospital and in-hospital emergency care, adhering to established standards, protocols, and procedures within the paramedic's scope of practice. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Complete assigned responsibilities in accordance with hospital, division, and EMS guidelines, standards, and directives, under the supervision of the charge paramedic or section-head. Provide high-quality patient care, both pre-hospital and in-hospital, based on a competent understanding of patient needs and established policies, procedures, and protocols. Deliver attentive patient care thoroughly, efficiently, and cost-effectively, while maintaining awareness of the patient's physical, medical, and cultural needs. Operate and maintain EMS vehicles and equipment properly to prevent damage. Prepare and complete all required reports and maintain patient confidentiality. Administrative and Operational Duties Ensure EMS vehicles, equipment, and supplies are in a constant state of readiness. Adhere to and implement EMS administrative and medical control directives. Complete administrative and clinical functions as assigned by the charge paramedic or section-head. Ensure proper utilization and assignment of staff on duty and actively participate in EMS staff meetings. Professional Development and Quality Improvement Attend skills maintenance programs to ensure professional proficiency and maintain professional licensure and required certifications. Participate in the development and presentation of educational awareness programs and assist in the orientation and professional development of other EMS personnel. Attend professional development courses and participate in professional research programs. Provide continuous feedback to improve the working environment and patient care, striving to deliver a higher level of quality care. Utilize medical supplies properly to avoid wastage and assist in situational problem-solving and resource utilization. Participate in and support quality improvement and patient safety activities. Teamwork and Professionalism Work in partnership with members of the EMS team and other healthcare professionals, promoting a positive attitude. Maintain a professional image and proper grooming at all times. Be punctual, organize daily tasks and break times efficiently, and respect patients and their families to promote a patient-centered care culture. Perform other related duties as required. Required Qualifications 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Working knowledge of current trends in EMS and new developments in the healthcare field. Ability to improve communications in English and Arabic.

467b08ebe032b820.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة بوابة السفر لخدمات المعتمرين عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ سياسات المبيعات، ومتابعة الأداء، وتقييم النتائج لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تطورات السوق وتحديد الأهداف التسويقية، وتطوير طرق البيع، وتقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع، وتحويل الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، وتقييم البرامج الترويجية لضمان فعاليتها. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد احتياجاتهم ومشكلاتهم، ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المحتملة. تقييم أداء مندوبي المبيعات ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الفرص. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وقدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم الأداء وتحديد مجالات التحسين. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتقديم العروض التقديمية بوضوح. مهارات تنظيمية لإدارة الوثائق والبيانات بشكل فعال. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة مكة المكرمة. سيعمل أخصائي المبيعات ضمن فريق مكرس لتحقيق أهداف المبيعات وخدمة العملاء في قطاع خدمات المعتمرين. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في مؤسسة بوابة السفر لخدمات المعتمرين.

468ce6b2f8d828a7.description: About BAE Systems Saudi Arabia BAE Systems Saudi Arabia, through its International Systems Engineering (ISE) division, provides IT capabilities and services to all projects and programs within BAE Systems Saudi Arabia, as well as to partner companies including BAE Systems Saudi Development and Training and SMSCMC. ISE is committed to supporting the Saudi Arabian National Agenda, including Saudisation and the development of Saudi National capabilities through the growth of Saudi National Partner Companies, reinforcing industrialisation and partnerships. Role Overview The Senior Network Engineer Lead – ISE, based in Riyadh, is a full-time position responsible for the operation and support of network services. This role ensures optimal service availability and performance, meeting agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), customer requirements, and contractual obligations. The position involves both technical responsibilities and leadership in people management. Key Responsibilities People Management: Participate in talent identification and recruitment, lead and guide direct reports, set performance objectives, provide feedback, and promote a high-performance environment aligned with ISE values. Technical Operations: Install, maintain, troubleshoot, and administer existing and future network infrastructures. Interface with vendors for communication and issue resolution. Perform routine health checks and preventive measures on assigned systems. Monitor the network, reporting failures or degradations to senior team members and management. Conduct proof-of-concept deployments and troubleshoot issues to identify root causes. Adhere to and maintain ISE network operations and security standards. Maintain technical expertise across all operational network components. Administrative Support: Collaborate with other IT Operations groups for project support and daily operations. Communicate status, action plans, and resolutions for reported issues effectively. Provide quality support to internal and external customers and technology partners. Manage case escalations to the Network Operations Manager while maintaining customer communications. Provide assistance and guidance to junior team members. Documentation: Maintain up-to-date ISE operational documentation and generate technical documentation and guide manuals. Compensation and Benefits for Expatriate Employees Expatriate employees will receive a competitive salary, rent-free accommodation, and access to free recreation facilities within Company-secured accommodation. The package also includes a generous leave and travel allowance. Initial appointment to Saudi Arabia will be on single status, with the opportunity to apply for family relocation after employment commencement. A full health care scheme is provided within Saudi Arabia. Compensation and Benefits for Saudi National Employees Saudi National employees will receive a competitive salary and benefits package. This includes a generous leave and travel allowance, a full health care scheme, and access to subsidised recreational facilities.

46b250b52d8e31e9.description: About the Role Samara is seeking a Store Supervisor to join our team in Al Khobar. This full-time role involves overseeing and directing daily store operations, including activities, schedules, inventory management, and the distribution of materials and tools. The ideal candidate will have 3-5 years of relevant experience. Job Purpose The primary purpose of the Store Supervisor is to ensure the efficient and accurate management of store inventory and operations. This includes supervising the receipt, storage, and distribution of goods, maintaining precise records, and coordinating with other departments to optimize workflow. Key Responsibilities Oversee the receipt and verification of incoming shipments, ensuring materials are unloaded, stored, and verified in accordance with company policy. Maintain accurate inventory records according to established procedures. Ensure the orderly storage of incoming shipments and maintain detailed records of available products and their storage locations. Communicate inventory review results to the manager and collaborate on scheduling future shipments. Delegate customer order fulfillment tasks to staff and update the inventory database upon order completion. Organize and maintain the inventory and storage areas. Ensure the accuracy of shipments and inventory transactions. Identify areas for improvement and establish innovative or adjust existing work procedures and practices. Confer and coordinate activities with other departments to ensure smooth operations. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in a supervisory or similar role within a retail or warehouse environment. Demonstrated ability to manage daily operations, inventory, and staff. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar. The role requires active participation in daily store operations and coordination with a team to achieve operational excellence. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

46bf8f5cdc951f88.job_title: DA & DSP Experience Specialist DA and DSP Experience
46bf8f5cdc951f88.description: About the Role Amazon Saudi Arabia is seeking a DA & DSP Experience Specialist to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on enhancing partnerships with last-mile delivery partners to ensure efficient and successful delivery operations. The specialist will be instrumental in building strong connections, establishing effective processes, and resolving issues to foster long-term successful collaborations. Key Responsibilities Collect and analyze insights from various listening channels to identify experience priorities for Delivery Associates (DAs) and Delivery Service Partners (DSPs). Consolidate feedback and collaborate cross-functionally with operations, ACES, and DEX teams to address structural challenges within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Conduct regular roundtables with partners to monitor sentiment and maintain a pulse check on their experiences. Act as the primary voice for DAs and DSPs within Amazon Saudi Arabia, advocating for their needs and improvements. Create a clear communication funnel to leadership regarding key priorities identified from partner feedback. Work Environment and Team The specialist will be based at one of Amazon Logistics (AMZL) sites, which handles last-mile delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. Being on-site provides direct visibility into the delivery process, enabling effective guidance for logistics partners. The AMZL team utilizes creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to deliver products to customers, aiming for a smooth delivery experience and global delivery solutions for new concepts. Required Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

46bf9304b5563345.description: About the Role Aluminum International Co. (ALINCO) is seeking a Sales Representative to join their team in Dammam, Eastern region. This is a full-time position responsible for driving sales growth by developing and maintaining strong client relationships. The role requires a proactive approach to identifying customer needs and providing effective solutions. Role Overview The Sales Representative will focus on expanding the company's client base and nurturing existing relationships. This involves understanding market dynamics, preparing compelling sales proposals, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction throughout the sales cycle. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong communication skills and a commitment to achieving sales objectives. Key Responsibilities Identify and pursue new business opportunities. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and new clients. Conduct market research to stay informed about industry trends and competitor activities. Prepare and present sales proposals to clients. Collaborate with the marketing team to align sales strategies with promotional activities. Provide customer service and support throughout the sales process. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in sales or a related field. A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred. Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets. 461e88804e87e903.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب تقويم أسنان ووجه وفكين للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تشخيص وعلاج أمراض الفم والأسنان التي تتطلب تدخلات تقويمية وجراحية، مع التركيز على تقديم خطط علاجية شاملة ومتابعة المرضى. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان التي تحتاج إلى عمليات وأجهزة تقويم لجميع أفراد الأسرة، وإعداد الخطط العلاجية المناسبة. إجراء المعالجات السنية اللازمة ومتابعة تجهيز وتركيب وتثبيت التقويمات السنية. معالجة التهابات اللثة وإجراء جراحات تقويم الفكين الصغرى، ووصف العلاجات والأدوية الضرورية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها بشكل دقيق. إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المريض وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة، وتحليلها لتشخيص حالة الفك والأسنان بدقة، ثم إعداد خطة التقويم والعلاج وبرنامجها الزمني. تجهيز وتطبيق التقويمات للفك والأسنان، وتحديد احتياجات المريض للتقويم، وأخذ القياسات، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص الأسنان والوجه والفكين وتشخيص أمراضها ومعالجة التشوهات، وإجراء الجراحات التقويمية الصغرى ووصف العلاجات والأدوية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال طب تقويم الأسنان والوجه والفكين. متابعة جميع أفراد الأسرة وملاحظة أمراض الأسنان والوجه والفكين الوراثية والعمل على الوقاية منها. إعداد تقارير وتقديم التوصيات لتحسين الصحة العامة للأسنان والتقليل من المخاطر التي تهددها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال تقويم الأسنان والوجه والفكين. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة وإعداد خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وتقديم الرعاية اللازمة. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل جدة، مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

46694f8fb198c21a.description: About the Role Chalhoub Group is seeking a Sales and Education Manager for Sol de Janeiro in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 46b08a27255cddf7.description: تعلن الشركة عن رغبتها في استقطاب مهندس ميكانيكي مؤهل للانضمام إلى فريق العمل، على أن يتولى الإشراف على أعمال الأنظمة الميكانيكية في الموقع، بما يشمل أنظمة التكييف والتهوية، وأنظمة مكافحة الحريق، وأعمال السباكة، والتأكد من تنفيذها وفقاً للمخططات المعتمدة والمواصفات الفنية ومعايير الجودة والسلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات: الإشراف على تنفيذ وتركيب أنظمة التكييف والتهوية ومكافحة الحريق والسباكة. مراجعة المخططات والرسومات الهندسية والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية المعتمدة. متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية للمعدات والأنظمة الميكانيكية. التأكد من جودة الأعمال المنفذة والالتزام بالمعايير الهندسية ومتطلبات السلامة. التنسيق مع فرق العمل والمقاولين والاستشاريين لضمان سير الأعمال وفقاً للجدول الزمني المحدد. متابعة كفاءة المعدات والأنظمة ومعالجة المشكلات الفنية التي قد تطرأ أثناء التنفيذ أو التشغيل. إعداد التقارير الفنية الدورية وتوثيق الأعمال المنفذة وملاحظات الموقع. الحصول على درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة الميكانيكية، وهو شرط أساسي للتقدم للوظيفة. ان يكون المتقدم حديث تخرج وليس على رأس العمل نظراً لحاجة الشركة للمرشحين بأسرع وقت ممكن. الالتزام بالمواعيد والأنظمة والتعليمات المعمول بها في الشركة. تفاصيل الوظيفة وشروط العمل: الراتب الإجمالي الشهري : 8500 ريال سعودي، غير قابل للتفاوض. أيام العمل : 5 أيام في الأسبوع الإجازة الأسبوعية : يومان أسبوعياً. ساعات العمل: 8 ساعات عمل يومياً، من الساعة 8 صباحاً حتى 4:00 مساءاً. موقع العمل: العمل مكتبي ولكن قد يتطلب الوجود الميداني. ملاحظة مهمه : جهة التعاقد: سيتم إبرام عقد العمل مع الشركة المشغّلة، وفقاً للشروط والأحكام المعتمدة لديها.

4678f53e9c9943b0.description: About the Role Dhahran Hills Advertising Agency is seeking an Operations Supervisor to manage the day-to-day operations of its factory in Al Khobar. 4670d49e9973f3e2.description: About the Role King Khaled Eye Specialist Hospital is seeking an Infectious Diseases Consultant to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves providing expert consultation and active participation in hospital programs related to infectious diseases and infection prevention. 46d0f4470468af55.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة ساج الركايا عن توفر شاغر وظيفي لـ مدير مشاريع للعمل بدوام كامل ضمن مشروع إنشاء مصنع الشركة في منطقة القصيم، بمدينة بريدة. نبحث عن مرشح يمتلك خبرة 8 سنوات في إدارة وتنفيذ المشاريع الصناعية، وخاصة مشاريع إنشاء المصانع والمنشآت المعدنية. الغرض من الوظيفة يتولى مدير المشاريع مسؤولية الإشراف على جميع مراحل المشروع، بدءًا من التخطيط وحتى التسليم النهائي، مع ضمان سير الأعمال وفقًا للخطط الزمنية والميزانيات المعتمدة والمواصفات الفنية المطلوبة. يهدف الدور إلى تحقيق أهداف المشروع بكفاءة وفعالية، مع الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة وتخطيط ومتابعة تنفيذ مشاريع إنشاء المصانع والمنشآت المعدنية. الإشراف على جميع مراحل المشروع، بدءًا من التخطيط وحتى التسليم النهائي. إعداد الخطط الزمنية للمشاريع ومتابعة نسب الإنجاز وضمان الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية المعتمدة. الإشراف على أعمال الإنشاءات المدنية وتركيب الهياكل والمنشآت المعدنية. التنسيق مع الفرق الهندسية والمقاولين والاستشاريين والموردين لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. متابعة التكاليف والميزانيات وإدارة الموارد والمعدات والعمالة. التأكد من تطبيق معايير الجودة والسلامة والالتزام بالمواصفات الفنية ومتطلبات المشروع. معالجة التحديات الفنية والتشغيلية وإيجاد الحلول المناسبة لضمان استمرارية العمل. إعداد التقارير الدورية عن تقدم المشروع ورفعها إلى الإدارة. مراجعة المخططات الهندسية ومتابعة تنفيذ الأعمال وفقًا للمخططات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية 8 سنوات في إدارة وتنفيذ المشاريع الصناعية، وخاصة مشاريع إنشاء المصانع والمنشآت المعدنية. مهارات قيادية وتنظيمية عالية. القدرة على إدارة فرق العمل بفعالية. القدرة على اتخاذ القرارات وحل المشكلات بفاعلية. بيئة العمل يقع مكان العمل في القصيم، وتحديدًا في موقع مشروع إنشاء المصنع بمدينة بريدة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع للإشراف المباشر على سير الأعمال. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية. نشجع المرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

46b7058f44b522cf.description: About the Role Value International Group is seeking a Value Engineering Specialist to join its Technical Department. 46062c011952d128.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات عن معالج صحة فم وأسنان للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم خدمات صحة الفم الأساسية بهدف الوقاية من أمراض واضطرابات الأسنان والفم وعلاجها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مقابلة المرضى وفحصهم ومراجعة تاريخهم الطبي لفهم حالتهم الصحية الفموية. تقديم علاجات الأسنان الأساسية، بما في ذلك التنظيف وإزالة الرواسب وملء التجاويف، واستخدام الفلورايد، وإعطاء التخدير الموضعي. تقديم المشورة للأفراد والمجتمعات بخصوص النظافة الصحية للأسنان، والحميات الغذائية، وغيرها من التدابير الوقائية والعلاجية لمشكلات الفم الصحية. تحضير أدوات الأسنان وتنظيفها وتعقيمها، بالإضافة إلى إعداد أوعية المعدات. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال صحة الفم والأسنان. القدرة على تقديم خدمات صحة الفم الوقائية والعلاجية الأساسية. فهم جيد لمبادئ النظافة الصحية للأسنان والوقاية من الأمراض الفموية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. تتطلب الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية في بيئة عمل عيادة الأسنان. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم. سيتم تحديد الراتب بعد المقابلة.

This includes managing and monitoring systems to ensure high availability and executing both preventive and corrective maintenance activities. The role is critical for maintaining the operational integrity of our IT environment. Key Responsibilities Manage and monitor all installed systems and infrastructure to ensure high availability. Install, configure, test, and maintain operating systems, application software, and system management tools. Monitor and test application performance, identify potential bottlenecks, and collaborate with developers on solutions. Liaise with vendors and other IT personnel for problem resolution. Execute maintenance duties according to the maintenance plan, including preventive procedures and schedules. Inspect and verify the status of assets and spare parts, performing corrective maintenance, repairs, and adjustments as needed. Submit maintenance checklist reports in accordance with work orders and maintenance plans. Troubleshoot issues by consulting as-built documents, schematics, and other relevant sources. Demonstrated ability to manage and monitor complex IT systems and infrastructure. Proficiency in installing, configuring, and maintaining operating systems and application software. 4683696ae815085c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فن المعمار السعودية للصيانة عن مراقب جودة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان التزام المنتجات بمعايير الجودة المطلوبة من خلال الفحص والتحليل المستمر. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى مراقب الجودة مسؤولية جمع عينات المنتجات وفحصها وتحليلها، بالإضافة إلى مراجعة سياسات وإجراءات الجودة ومراقبتها. يهدف الدور إلى تحديد مصادر العيوب وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة لتحسين جودة المنتجات والعمليات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع عينات تصنيع من مراحل مختلفة من عملية التصنيع، بما في ذلك المنتجات قيد التصنيع والمنتجات النهائية. إجراء الفحوصات اللازمة لعينات منتجات عملية التصنيع، والتحقق من الالتزام بمعايير الجودة المطلوبة. توثيق النتائج التي يتم التوصل إليها من خلال عمليات الفحص والتحليل. تحديد مصادر العيوب في المنتجات أو العمليات، ووضع التوصيات للتخفيف من آثارها. تحديث سياسات وإجراءات الجودة وفقاً للمتطلبات والمعايير الجديدة. الحفاظ على الخبرات الفنية وتحديث المعرفة حول اتجاهات القطاع واللوائح الحكومية ذات الصلة بالجودة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال مراقبة الجودة أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع العينات وفحصها وتحليلها بدقة. معرفة بسياسات وإجراءات الجودة ومعاييرها. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. يعمل مراقب الجودة ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان أعلى مستويات الجودة في جميع مراحل التصنيع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

46ff72970a27dceb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن أمين مستودع فني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى إدارة المخزون بفعالية، بما في ذلك استلام المواد وفحصها وتخزينها وصرفها، مع الحفاظ على سجلات دقيقة. يتطلب الدور التنسيق المستمر مع أقسام المشتريات والإنتاج لضمان توفر المواد ومنع النقص، مما يساهم في كفاءة وسلامة عمليات المستودع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديث سجلات المخزون ومتابعة مستوياته بشكل دوري، وتنفيذ عمليات الجرد لضمان دقة البيانات. فحص المواد الواردة والتحقق من مطابقتها للمواصفات، ثم تخزينها بأمان ووفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة. صرف المواد للفرق المعنية وتوثيق حركة الصرف بدقة لضمان تتبع المخزون. تحديث أنظمة المخزون وإعداد الوثائق والتقارير اللازمة حول حركة المواد ومستوياتها. الالتزام بجميع متطلبات السلامة والجودة المعمول بها في المستودع لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. التنسيق الفعال مع أقسام المشتريات والخدمات اللوجستية والإنتاج لمنع أي نقص في المواد وضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدارة المستودعات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إدارة المخزون وتحديث السجلات بدقة. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة والجودة في بيئة المستودعات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور العمل في بيئة مستودع، مع التركيز على الدقة والتنسيق الفعال مع الأقسام الأخرى. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

46603bfc00c3f681.description: Job description Assistant Manager – Engineering & Smart Asset Management Posting Date : 15/10/2026 Ref : ITKSA114 Position : Assistant Manager – Engineering & Smart Asset Management Location : KSA City : Riyadh Sector : Hospitality Years of Experience 5–7 years of engineering/facilities maintenance experience with at least 2 years in a supervisory role. Resolve work orders, monitor system performance, and reduce reactive failures through preventive maintenance schedules. Comprehensive medical insurance, annual flight benefits, and annual leave in accordance with company policy and Saudi Labor Law. End-of-service benefits and opportunities for professional growth in smart building technologies and asset management. 469188098290ef6d.description: Job description The Fire Safety Engineer is responsible for delivering technical fire and life safety engineering activities across KAUST under the direction of the Fire Safety Engineering Lead. The role supports KAUST's delegated Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) governance framework by conducting technical reviews, field assessments, inspections, compliance verification, fire risk assessments, and technical investigations within approved KAUST procedures and delegated authorities. The role prepares technical recommendations for review and approval through the Lead, Fire Safety Engineer and the Health and Safety Manager, as applicable. The Fire Safety Engineer also supports compliance with Saudi Civil Defense requirements, Saudi Building Code (SBC), National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), International Fire Code (IFC), and KAUST requirements by maintaining audit-ready evidence, verifying fire protection system performance, supporting Civil Defense-related documentation and inspections where applicable, and escalating significant fire and life safety risks. Responsibilities Conduct fire and life safety engineering reviews, assessments, inspections, and field verifications. Review fire safety requirements for new construction, renovations, research facilities, high-hazard areas, and fire protection systems. Ensure compliance with SBC, NFPA, IFC, KAUST requirements, and Saudi Civil Defense requirements. Conduct fire risk assessments, inspections, system verification, and compliance checks, and recommend corrective actions. Review and maintain fire safety documentation, drawings, test certificates, inspection records, ITM records, and deficiency closure evidence. Coordinate with Projects, Facilities, contractors, consultants, Fire & Emergency Services, and other stakeholders to resolve fire safety issues. Provide technical assurance for Inspection, Testing & Maintenance (ITM) of fire protection systems and monitor corrective actions. Participate in testing, commissioning, acceptance, and functional verification of fire alarms, suppression systems, smoke control, passive fire protection, fire doors, barriers, and egress systems. Support investigations of fire incidents, unwanted alarms, system failures, and impairments, including root cause analysis and corrective actions. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

46979b0a5fce6d07.description: Electrical Project Engineer Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Department: Projects & Real Estate Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Electrical Project Engineer to oversee and coordinate electrical engineering activities across real estate development, construction, and facility improvement projects. The role involves ensuring that electrical installations and project deliverables are completed according to approved designs, technical specifications, project schedules, safety regulations, and quality standards. Key Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate electrical works across construction, real estate development, and renovation projects. Review electrical drawings, technical specifications, shop drawings, and material submittals to ensure compliance with project requirements. Monitor project progress and ensure electrical activities are completed within approved timelines, budgets, and quality standards. Coordinate with contractors, consultants, suppliers, and internal project teams to resolve technical and operational issues. Oversee electrical installations, including power distribution, lighting systems, low-current systems, and related infrastructure. Conduct site inspections and monitor the quality of electrical works to ensure compliance with applicable codes and safety requirements. Support testing, commissioning, inspections, and handover activities for completed electrical systems. Identify project risks, technical challenges, and potential delays, and recommend corrective actions. Prepare project progress reports, technical documentation, and updates for management. Ensure compliance with Saudi electrical regulations, relevant technical standards, and HSE requirements. Requirements Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field. 3–5 years of relevant experience in electrical engineering, preferably within construction, real estate development, or facility projects. Strong knowledge of electrical systems, power distribution, lighting, and low-current systems. Experience reviewing electrical drawings, technical specifications, and construction documentation. Familiarity with Saudi Building Code (SBC), applicable IEC standards, and electrical safety requirements. Proficiency in AutoCAD and Microsoft Office. Knowledge of Revit MEP, MS Project, or Primavera P6 is an advantage. Strong technical problem-solving, communication, and project coordination skills. Ability to work effectively with contractors, consultants, and multidisciplinary project teams. 465cc74f92e9f587.description: At Salla, we are building the digital backbone of commerce in the region, empowering thousands of merchants to start, grow, and scale their businesses. Build reviews that buyers trust and merchants can use, including for stores with few or no reviews.
